name: io.github.LaghariLabs/adversaria-mcp
title: Adversaria
description: Read-only access to your local Adversaria meeting notes and to-dos. Runs on your machine, opens the desktop app's SQLite database read-only, and makes no network calls of its own.

environmentVariables.name: ADVERSARIA_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Adversaria meetings.db. Defaults to the desktop app's location for your OS; set this only if your database lives elsewhere.
